purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
summary: Official TKGM evidence identifies SAKARYA KADASTRO MÜDÜRLÜĞÜ, and Sakarya Metropolitan Municipality exposes map administration pages. No anonymous, city-bounded parcel ID plus geometry response was verified. This is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
queryOutcomes: English and Turkish first-party discovery queries are recorded in city-4032-sakarya.json. They found the official TKGM viewer, local cadastral custodian and municipal map pages, but no usable public parcel feature response.
requestOutcomes: Direct TKGM viewer curl failed host resolution and independent web fetch returned 502; the official municipal map and Adapazarı detail pages returned 200 but exposed only static/index map material. No login, credential, private token or unsafe field request was made.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [40.7632117164762, 30.4078913508982] was preserved; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
No city boundary or complete Sakarya coverage was established for an open geometry service.
No parcel geometry or raw source-specific attribute set was retained.
The national TKGM viewer and general institutional prose are not treated as proof of a qualified local adapter.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only, if independently confirmed
source layer and public service metadata
excludedFields: tax/account/registration details beyond a safe native parcel ID
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; no synthetic identity was created. A future sample must contain exactly one stable native identity in GeoJSON properties, with source field mapping documented here.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
uncertainty: Local cadastral custody is evidenced, but anonymous viewer/API access, city scope, schema, CRS, native identity and parcel geometry remain unknown. DNS failure, 502, static-map success or lack of a visible endpoint is not evidence of citywide absence.
